tools.name: search_contracts
tools.description: Search active US federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov. Useful for finding RFPs, solicitations, and government procurement opportunities.

tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Search active US federal grant opportunities from Grants.gov. Covers all federal agencies and funding types.

tools.name: search_awards
tools.description: Search historical US federal contract award data for price intelligence. Find out what similar contracts paid and who won them.

tools.name: search_spending
tools.description: Search federal award spending data from USAspending.gov. Find awards by keyword, look up a company total federal contracts, or see agency spending breakdown.
